name: Rhihimon
main_effect:
When one of your Digimon with a Tamer card in its digivolution cards would digivolve into this card in your hand, reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by 2.
[On Deletion] If a card with the [Hybrid] trait is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, you may play 1 purple Tamer card from your trash without paying its memory cost.
